# Dmitrii Zhukov, Senior Technical Writer

> Senior Technical Writer and Product Documentation Lead with 10 years in fintech, asset
> management and B2B SaaS. This site is a portfolio: product documentation samples,
> documentation tooling, an API reference, and working artifacts about writing
> documentation that an AI retrieval system can answer from.

Base URL: https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/
Contact: storiesbydz@gmail.com
Location: Belgrade, Serbia (CET). Open to relocation, remote, hybrid or on-site.

## Portfolio: product documentation

- [Overview](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/portfolio-overview): what is in this portfolio and where to start.
- [Algorithmic Reconciliation](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/Case-1-Algo-Recon): knowledge base guide explaining a fuzzy-logic matching engine to quantitative analysts and fund accountants.
- [Approver Mobile App](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/Case-2-Approver-App): step-by-step setup and operation guide for a transaction approval app.
- [General Ledger Manager](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/Case-3-GL-Manager): getting-started guide for GL entries and allocation rules.
- [Optimizer](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/Case-4-Optimizer): reference and onboarding guide for a C# scripting environment.
- [Transaction Matching](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/Case-5-Transaction-Matching): guide explaining algorithmic transaction matching across heterogeneous data sources.
- [Release Notes](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/releasenotes): release communication sample.

## Portfolio: documentation engineering

- [Automation Scripts](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/code-samples): production Python tool that compiles release notes source material from TFS queries.
- [Pipeline Simulator](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/dz-pipeline-simulator): interactive artifact documenting a Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Metabase data platform.

## Portfolio: AI and RAG

- [Writing for AI Retrieval](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/ai-retrieval): rules for content that survives chunking, and the failure each one prevents.
- [Documentation Assistant](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/docs-assistant): retrieval assistant over the five knowledge base guides, with worked cases and a documented retrieval defect found in them.
- [Retrieval Pipeline](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/retrieval-pipeline): one question walked through seven pipeline stages, with failure ownership per stage.
- [RAG Evaluation in CI](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/rag-evaluation): agent answers as a test suite gating documentation changes.

## API documentation

- [API Reference](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/api): hand-written reference for a fictional treasury API.
- [Conventions](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/api/conventions): pagination, filtering, rate limits, idempotency, versioning, data formats.
- [Errors](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/api/errors): error envelope, status code catalogue, retry guidance.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/openapi/dz-api.yaml): the machine-readable contract the reference is generated from.

## About

- [Competence and expertise](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/expertise): skills, tools, achievements, availability.
- [How I Work](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/docs/portfolio/How-I-Work): information architecture, docs-as-code pipeline, release workflow, quality loop.
- [Articles](https://thenameisdmitry.github.io/KBDZ/articles): writing on documentation practice and AI-assisted workflows.
